info.title: Rafik API â€” Coach Field App
info.description: Supported API surface for the coach-first Android field app. The complete backend route reference is in docs/reference/api.md. Instance URLs are university-operated; do not use a shared Rafik host. Canonical institution routes resolve the installation institution server-side. Beta.3 removes workspace/organization aliases and generic command/query/file gateways. Upgrade the backend, web and Android together; beta.2 clients are unsupported. Current institution IDs, exact receipts and queued institutional command payloads remain stable.

post.summary: Sign in to one institution on this device

get.summary: List the current account's institution membership
Read a bounded schedule or one authorized event
get.description: Send view=trainer and a bounded from/to calendar-date window, or supply id to read one event detail before field work. The server checks current assignment and membership. For online-only correction history, send id, historyOnly=true, historyMember, historyKind (attendance or results) and historyOffset. Each read rechecks event authority; the selected athlete must be an event participant. History returns up to 25 items and next offset; it includes the original entry and later corrections, with recorded actor, timestamp and submitted values. Unreleased beta.3 adds explicit includeDayOnly opt-in. Existing Android attendance clients keep timed-only reads; a matching new native workout slice is still required.

parameters.name: historyOnly
parameters.description: Return only an authorized participant history page; requires id and historyMember.

parameters.name: includeDayOnly
parameters.description: Opt in to day-only training events. Their starts_at/ends_at are null; use training_date/timezone. Without this flag lists remain timed-only; requesting a day-only detail returns day_only_event_requires_update.

anyOf.description: Schedule page or full event detail when historyOnly is absent.

post.summary: Record attendance, assessment results, or finish an event
post.description: Every write uses an operation UUID and the current event/participant revision. Queue dependent commands in order. Retry an uncertain result with the exact same operation and payload. Authorization and revisions are rechecked by the server.

post.summary: Schedule, reschedule or explicitly skip an individual plan workout
post.description: Unreleased beta.3 server slice. Explicit staff scheduling uses fixed times; a day-only worker occurrence can be converted to a timed occurrence through reschedule. Binds the next non-rest day from the immutable plan cycle without advancing its cursor. One unresolved workout blocks that assignment only. Skip requires a staff reason; completion advances through the existing session save command. Uses exact operation receipts and rechecks current plan authority before replay. Recurring/automatic preparation is configured through workout-rules. Group workout capture and new Android workout UI remain pending.

200.description: Scheduled occurrence/position, rescheduled occurrence/position, or skip acknowledgment; exact retries return the original response.

400.description: Invalid date/time, timezone or skip reason.

403.description: Current staff membership or plan-specific authority missing.

409.description: Stale cursor/revision, unresolved predecessor, participation restriction, calendar collision, or a date/day identity already recorded.

get.summary: Read authorized next-workout state without choosing an athlete first
get.description: Unreleased beta.3 web integration. Read-only projection; never allocates a sequence position. Returns next immutable plan day, pending occurrence, resumable record, general participation restriction and action flags. Coach scope is primary athletes plus supporting sport-specific plans. Athlete scope is own assignments. due=true includes workouts awaiting scheduling, today/overdue unresolved occurrences and unfinished older records, in the signed-in account timezone. Day-only occurrences have null starts_at/ends_at and an explicit training_date/timezone. Day-only eligibility uses that timezone; clients must not invent a clock time.

parameters.name: due
parameters.description: Include workouts awaiting scheduling, due today, overdue or unfinished; excludes future scheduled work.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Optional dashboard queue, filtered before pagination. actionable combines due positions and unfinished recordings once per assignment; planning contains neither. recording/today remain narrower read filters. The response echoes the queue to detect mismatched backend versions.

200.description: WorkoutAgenda: items, total, offset and bounded limit. Each item contains assignment_id, member_id/name, title, goal, cursor, next day, state, general blocked reason, occurrence, session, can_start and can_schedule. Shared TypeScript shape: packages/shared/src/contracts.ts.

post.summary: Start or save individual workout results
post.description: Current athlete self-recording and authorized delegated coach recording. A sequence-bound start supplies its occurrence ID and must wait until the booked time. Save actual reps/load/time/distance/effort with the current workout version as revision. Completed bound work resolves its assignment position atomically once; subsequent corrections preserve progression. Generic attendance does not complete a workout. Administrators do not record results. New Android offline workout capture is not implemented by this contract.

200.description: Workout document, including ID, version, prescription and actual entries; an exact retry returns its saved response.

409.description: Stale version, future start, inactive/paused position, or another unresolved position.

get.summary: Read one authorized plan’s scheduling policy and worker diagnostics

200.description: scheduler_enabled and up to 25 policies, active first. Dates, weekdays (ISO Monday=1), local_time/duration or null for automatic mode, last_generated_on, last_checked_at and general issue codes.

post.summary: Set or stop future weekly/automatic workout preparation
post.description: Unreleased beta.3. Opt-in per plan. Exact operation receipt and current plan authority required on replay. Set replaces the active rule; rule_id/revision must match (null/null for manual). Existing materialized work is not changed: use workout-scheduling for that occurrence. Weekly rules use one uniquely resolvable local clock; DST gaps/folds surface an issue without shifting time. Automatic mode prepares the current eligible non-rest day with no clock time, at most once per assignment/day. Unresolved work blocks only that assignment. No missed-date backfill or group progression. A post-acknowledgment worker kick/poll is separate from saving the policy. Published program prescriptions may set boolean automaticPreparation for new assignment defaults. Delivery confirms or overrides with automatic_preparation, timezone and bounded end_date; assignment and policy are atomic. Program edits never change existing policies.

200.description: Saved rule or stop acknowledgment. Preparation happens separately and may be blocked.

400.description: Invalid date window (maximum 366 days), weekday, timezone, time or duration.

409.description: Stale rule identity/revision or unavailable assignment.

post.summary: Adapt an existing athlete plan without publishing a library copy
post.description: Unreleased beta.3. This documented subset is POST delivery action=adapt. Administrator or current primary/sport-scoped supporting coach authority is required before receipt replay. Supply exact operation, view, assignment ID, expected assignment revision, source_version_id, title and full valid draft prescription. A stale new request fails with conflict. Store a validated assignment-local snapshot and increment its revision; do not create a program/version, replace the assignment, reset its sequence cursor or change its preparation policy. Existing scheduled/started workout snapshots stay fixed; future preparation uses the adapted ordered cycle. Prior snapshots remain in institutional audit history. The same route also supports the existing assign/end lifecycle described in the API guide.

200.description: Acknowledged assignment and personalized snapshot. Replay returns the original receipt after current authority checks.

409.description: Stale assignment/source identity or inactive assignment.

webSession.name: rafik_session
webSession.description: Existing browser session; browser writes also require X-Rafik-Client: web. Swagger uses native bearer requests without cookies.

id.description: Composite institution/role context ID; use institution_id for API paths.

role.description: Stable wire roles: administrator, coach and athlete respectively.

path.description: Browser destination /dashboard. Native clients use the stable workspace and member IDs.

operation.description: Stable idempotency ID; preserve the exact payload on retry.

FieldHistoryPage.description: Online-only selected-participant history, including original entry and later corrections. Newest first.

starts_at.description: Explicit UTC offset or Z required.

timezone.description: IANA timezone; the session date is derived here.

starts_at.description: Explicit UTC offset or Z required.

timezone.description: IANA timezone; the session date is derived here.

occurrence_id.description: Required for sequence-bound work; omitted only for existing unlinked workflows.

can_record.description: Current plan-scoped coach can continue this workout; writes reauthorize.

preview.description: Bounded preview from the immutable assigned workout. Muscle focus ranks declared metadata by exercise frequency, not physiological load.

queue.description: Echo of requested queue; null when no queue was requested.

WorkoutRuleCommand.description: For set-workout-rule also provide mode/starts_on/ends_on/timezone; weekly additionally requires weekdays/local_time/duration_minutes. Automatic ignores weekly-only fields. Stop changes only the future policy.

draft.description: Full valid schema-2 prescription; catalog/media authority is revalidated.
